Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed next steps

Hi Emma — great to meet you and the Finovate team today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we’re aligned:

Highlights from today’s discovery:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization and assistive search for internal KB (60–80% of volume in first 90 days)
- Current constraints: latency SLOs (p95 < 350ms on short queries), strict data retention rules for EU/US customers, and inference cost sensitivity for high-volume queries
- Success metric: reduce average handle time by 20% and lower token cost per query by 30% month-over-month

Proposed next steps (if you’re aligned):
1) Pilot scope: 1 team (Customer Support), 2k daily queries, 30-day pilot — Redwood Dedicated w/ KV caching + optimized batching
2) Technical kick-off: architecture alignment + KMS checklist — target week of Mar 15
3) Procurement: estimate & mutual action plan (MAP) for internal approvals — I attached a draft MAP (20270301-Redwood-MAP-Redwood-vFinovate.pdf)

Can you confirm whether the pilot scope/timing looks reasonable and if there are any procurement dates we should be aware of? If yes, I’ll get Karthik to schedule a technical kickoff and share an updated MAP with a tailored MLP (minimum lovable product) for CS.

Attachments: 20270301-Redwood-MAP-Redwood-vFinovate.pdf (draft MAP, pricing bands, standard SOW outline)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543210

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
